1,080 done episode(s) in the campaign's analysis, plus 1 badged EXCLUDED — an excluded episode is still on disk and still status = "done", so it is listed here as the evidence it is rather than dropped, and it is in no estimate anywhere. 18 rows carry a full interactive page and are the only ones whose page cell is a link — see the hub for why those were the ones chosen. The remaining rows are complete as data; their episode JSON, transcripts and prompt views are in the run directory named in the hazard column's tooltip. cf agreement is the share of committed moves that BOTH computable rules would also have played, and is blank rather than zero wherever it was not computed. An onset of censored is the absence of a collusion-onset event, not an event at stage zero.
